claim: MT6785 md1rom ISA is byte-verifiable; nanoMIPS hypothesis from prior art is testable in Ghidra
verdict: nanoMIPS OVERTURNED for MT6785 md1rom: MIPS32 LE entry code + MIPS16e-compressed code islands (hybrid); microMIPS and nanoMIPS both ruled out at decode level

input.extraction: mtk_hdr chain, no ELF header (census F-16)

method.tool: Ghidra 12.2 PUBLIC headless (no auto-analysis, cold-start forced disassembly)
method.metric: per 256-byte window: clearListing + forced disassembly from window start; coverage = valid instruction bytes / 256 (F-20/F-28 decode-density methodology)

entry_point.followed_by: 00 65 filler pattern to 0x30 (explains census 'no dominant ISA' at auto-analysis)

windows_compare.note: dense; mips32/16e share mips16.sinc - ISA-mode context
tail data region - partial decode in all 32-bit ISAs incl nanomips

nanomips_sweep_stats.conclusion: nanoMIPS decoder produces near-zero valid-code coverage on every MIPS16e-dense code island; only tail data windows (which decode partially in all 32-bit ISAs) exceed 20%

auto_analysis_pass.note: whole-image pass incl. data regions; strings harvested from defined data

prior_art_resolution.ncc_ghidra_mtk_loader: README: 'Currently, only nanoMIPS-based firmware is supported' - loader docs reference MT6879/NR16 build dated 2023 (Dimensity-era)
prior_art_resolution.taszk_2023_12_07: nanoMIPS decompiler/debugger/emulator for MediaTek basebands - Dimensity-generation work
prior_art_resolution.resolution: nanoMIPS attribution is generation-specific (MT6873+/5G-era); MT6785 is MOLY LR13-era (2020, Helio G95 4G) and uses the classic MIPS32+MIPS16e baseband architecture

install_notes: Ghidra 12.2 buildExtension.gradle requires Gradle >= 9.1; repo wrapper pinned 8.10.2 - bumped to gradle-9.9.1
Gradle <= 8.x cannot evaluate build scripts under JDK 25 ('Unsupported class file major version 69')
nanomips module is pure SLEIGH data: registered by copying repo layout to <ghidra>/Ghidra/Processors/nanomips/ (Module.manifest + data/languages + lib jar) - headless picks it up without GUI install
ghidra-mtk-loader container loader NOT built/used this pass (release zip targets Ghidra 12.1; same Gradle path applies) - INT_InitRegions_C segment expansion unexercised
negatives: Segment boundaries are coverage-derived only; no container-level segment map (loader not built)
0x80000/0x700000/0xe00000 decode densely under both MIPS32-default and 16e (shared mips16.sinc + ISA-mode context); per-instruction ISA-mode attribution not done
md1dsp (DSP! magic, Coresonic-class) remains not byte-verified (F-17)
Window step is 1 MiB - island boundaries coarse
